description: FlowBars Visual is a custom Power BI visual that shows progress toward targets through clear, segmented horizontal bars and hierarchical flow layouts. It helps teams compare Target vs Actual at multiple levels, highlight gaps instantly, and navigate performance drivers with an intuitive visual structure. This offer is ideal for BI analysts, finance teams, sales operations, controlling, and managers who monitor KPIs, budgets, quotas, and execution performance across categories, products, regions, or organizational hierarchies. Many teams struggle to read complex tables and standard charts when they need to understand where performance is on track or off track. FlowBarsVisual addresses this by turning dense data into a readable performance flow, reducing analysis time, improving decision speed, and making variance and contribution patterns easier to communicate.
